{{Quote|Take a Cosmic Chance on a rich, flavorful slider inspired by the one and only Gambler's World. Our regular patty is topped with sautéed Vorzydiak mushrooms and three kibi strips. If you're craving something exciting, this is a safe bet.|The description of the slider on the menu|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Vorzyd sliders''' were one of the standard [[slider]]s available on the menu at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The slider was designed by the establishment's [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who based it on inspiration from the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] world of [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] and considered it to be delicious. It consisted of a [[Mongo Beefhead patty]], sautéed [[Vorzydiak mushroom]]s, three [[Kibi strip/Legends|kibi strips]], and Dex's [[Slider garnish|special garnish]], all on a trans-shipped [[medium-density food-board]]. The sliders cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each, with [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] or [[Bimm mustard]] available upon request for no additional charge. The Vorzyd slider was served at Dex's Diner at some point<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vorzyd slider was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" />
